title: Myrtle Belvedere
description: The lower voice becomes the soloist in a five-beat elegy. Brief upper chords listen, interrupt and eventually answer. A tenor line grows over sustained bass notes in the middle, making the left hand its own small ensemble; the final sentence belongs to the original bass alone.
technical_note: Let the bass melody lead without becoming heavy. In the three-voice passage, sustain the bass with one finger while shaping the tenor independently. Place the upper replies gently and honour their written silences.

performance.note: Authored breathing, changing dialogue and independent voicing; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
